tasks.subject: Task 2: B — Cave Story settings.dat conform
tasks.description:

**Files:**
- Create: `assets/gt-nxengine-conform-layout.sh`
- Modify: `build/build-pak.sh`
- Test: `tests/test-15-nxengine-settings.sh`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] conform writes JUMP.jbut@136 / FIRE.jbut@160 = (3,4) nintendo / (4,3) xbox, only those bytes; size 964; NXS7 intact.

- [ ] Refuses non-NXS7 file.
- [ ] build-pak stages helper + injects gt-h700-nxengine-layout block after export GT_CONTROLLER_LAYOUT.

tasks.subject: Task 5: Device gate on the RG SP
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Build the pak, install on the RG SP, and confirm all three pieces work on-device before merge — with regressions checked.

**USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.** Requested by the user in the current conversation. MUST NOT be closed by walking around it, declaring it "verified inline", or substituting a cheaper check. Close only after every acceptanceCriteria item is re-validated independently with output captured.

**Files:** none (build + on-device verification)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] make pak builds clean (dangerouslyDisableSandbox), installed via unzip-over.
- [ ] A: per-game Nintendo/Xbox/Default each behave correctly; config.json gt-port-layout updated.
- [ ] A disclaimer shows on Balatro X.
- [ ] B: Cave Story jump/fire swap on layout flip; no-op relaunch preserves resolution + a rebind.
- [ ] C: global toggle visible without scrolling.
- [ ] Regression: Celeste + Tunics!/Sonic still switch; five covered ports unaffected.
